messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High p95 latency observed on inference-prod-us-east-1 (route: /v1/generate). Alert threshold crossed 3m ago. Auto-mitigation NOT triggered.
jon-oncall: I'm on it. Can someone post initial impact numbers (p50/p95, error rate)?
maria-eng: p50 ~ 120ms (steady), p95 jumped from ~450ms -> ~1.6s starting ~1779012200. Error rate unchanged. Throughput steady.
ashwin-sre: Confirming traces show long tail in kernel scheduling syscalls on a subset of hosts. Sharing sample span IDs: trace/0f3a2c, trace/7b1e9a.
bot-tracing: Link to flame graph + spans: https://traces.redwood/internal/0f3a2c (shortlived token)
liz-ops: I see recent node kernel upgrade rolled to pool-gpu-2 at 1779012100. Rolling window matches.
kevin-ml: Which models/seq lengths affected? Early look shows p95 impact concentrated on seq>512 requests.
maria-eng: Customer impact: approx 18% of requests hit p95 > 1s in the affected region, impacting 6 customers with heavy long-context usage. Carla, fyi for CS triage.
carla-customer-success: Noted. I'll draft comms and prioritize the 2 highest-usage customers. Any ETA for mitigation?
jon-oncall: Short-term mitigation: drain pool-gpu-2 nodes and route traffic to pool-gpu-1. Ashwin, can you coordinate drain now?
ashwin-sre: Starting cordon+drain on 3 nodes in pool-gpu-2: `kubectl cordon node-{a,b,c}` then `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets`. Pushing policy change to route away from pool-gpu-2.
maria-eng: Rolling routing change: set prefer_pool=gpu-1 for inference-prod-us-east-1 (canary to 5% then 100%). Kicking it now.
bot-tracing: After drain started, new traces show immediate p95 drop to ~520ms for routed traffic. Old in-flight KV cached sessions still tail.
jon-oncall: Good. Let's collect kernel perf counters from one affected host (node-a) before it's rebooted: `perf top -p <pid>`, `sudo perf record -a -g -o /tmp/perf.data -- sleep 30`.
ashwin-sre: Collected perf sample: heavy context-switch wait on futex/sys_sched_yield; C-state exits increased. Uploading sample: s3://redwood-ops/tmp/perf-node-a-1779012360.dat
maria-eng: Hypothesis 1: kernel scheduler patch changed wake-up latency for high concurrency threads -> p95 tail. Hypothesis 2: recent GLIBC change affecting pthread spin behavior for smaller batches.
kevin-ml: Adding ML angle: sequence>512 increases KV-cache pressure -> more memory accesses; if kernel scheduling degenerated, it amplifies tail. Suggest reproducer: run local sim with seq=1024 and burst concurrency 32.
ashwin-sre: I'll run the reproducer on a standby node and attach perf counters + ftrace. If we see same syscall patterns, we escalate to infra team.
carla-customer-success: Customers A and B emailed, asking for status. I'll update them: "mitigation in progress, routing shifted, monitoring p95 closely". Any note on ETA? We can give 60-90m for full flush.
jon-oncall: ETA 45-90m depending on drain/evict speed. Keep oncall updated. Please add all artifacts to the incident board: https://board.redwood/inc/1779012345
maria-eng: Action items: (1) SRE to confirm perf/ftrace reproducer results (ashwin). (2) Infra to roll back kernel change for pool-gpu-2 if reproduced (liz). (3) Engineering to run ML reproducer to validate seq-length sensitivity (kevin). (4) CS to notify impacted customers (carla).
ashwin-sre: Reproducer started on node-standby-4: `./loadtest --seq 1024 --concurrency 32 --duration 10m`. Attaching live logs: https://logs.redwood/node-standby-4/1779012380
bot-tracing: New trace aggregate after routing change: p50 130ms, p95 540ms, p99 980ms. Still above historical p95 ~450ms but much improved.
maria-eng: If perf reproducer confirms kernel schedule regression, request a kernel rollback for pool-gpu-2 and full re-validation.
liz-ops: I'm preparing rollback playbook. If SRE confirms, will orchestrate a controlled rollback with canary and health checks.
jon-oncall: Great. Keep updates short here. If you need more hands, ping `@sre-pager` and `@infra-leads`. :thumbsup:
carla-customer-success: Update sent to impacted customers at 1779012480. They appreciate quick action.
maria-eng: Logging hypothesis timeline in the RCA doc (link on incident board). Will add perf artifacts and trace links when available.
ashwin-sre: Preliminary reproducer shows same futex wait pattern. Uploading ftrace: s3://redwood-ops/tmp/ftrace-node-standby-4-1779012445.log
kevin-ml: ML reproducer shows p95 up ~3x for seq>512 when run concurrently. Confirming severity.
jon-oncall: Thanks team. Next updates in 20m or on major milestone (rollback started/completed).
